correctness.rationale: The exact incidence factorization, image/ker identities for the augmentation ideal under a linear coordinate change in a truncated polynomial algebra, and the all-ones preimage jointly prove ranks N-2, N/2-2, and 0 for powers one, two, and three. These ranks uniquely give the stated Jordan multiplicities. Dimension d=2 is explicitly checked and has T²=0; d>=3 has nonzero T², so the sharp index is three. Kernel differences give finite-field layer counts. A standalone checker recomputed ranks through d=7 and fully enumerated configurations in d=2,3; the infinite statement uses proof, not sampling.

value.rationale: A line-graph transformation turns reversible vertex-neighbor XOR (all odd cube dimensions) into uniformly three-step nilpotent edge-neighbor XOR (all dimensions >=3). The dimension-uniform Jordan decomposition and exact distribution of relaxation times settle a motivated infinite-family dynamical classification, with a nontrivial second-power rank that is not a mere table lookup.
